text: A visit isn't finished until its chart is signed. If a SOAP is still a draft at six p.m., Scout gives the doctor on the visit a task. It's our only warning about an unsigned chart.
Here it is on Dr. Lane's list: Finish the chart for Maple, from yesterday's visit.
The one thing to remember: open the SOAP from the task and sign it. The task closes the moment the chart is signed.
It says how long the SOAP has been open.
Don't use Mark complete to make it go away. If the chart is still a draft, the task comes back.
Maple's chart from yesterday. Check it's complete.
Signing needs three things: the client recap decided, doses and prescriptions done, and a weight.
Maria already heard the plan by phone, so click Don't email.
Click Sign and lock SOAP. Only a licensed veterinarian can sign.
The task is gone. Signing the chart closed it.
The most common mistakes: clicking Mark complete on a chart that isn't signed, and leaving a chart for a colleague without moving the task to them. Remember: open the SOAP from the task and sign it.
